# Lead Awaker

> Lead Awaker builds and runs "Sara", an AI receptionist for small and mid-sized service businesses. Sara answers the phone, WhatsApp and website chat day and night, answers questions from a brief written with the business owner, and books customers straight into the owner's calendar. Lead Awaker is based in 's-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands, and works in English, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese.

Lead Awaker is a one-person company founded by Gabriel Fronza. He sets up every receptionist himself and is the direct contact for every client. Legal name on the site: LeadAwaker, KvK (Dutch Chamber of Commerce) 99366738. Contact: admin@leadawaker.com.

## What the AI receptionist does

- Phone: missed calls, after-hours calls or all calls forward to Sara. The business keeps its own number. She picks up straight away, answers questions, and books an appointment or a callback.
- WhatsApp: customers send a question, a photo or a voice note. Sara replies in seconds and books them in.
- Website chat: a chat widget in the business's own colours answers visitors and books a free slot. Visitors can type, send a photo or leave a voice note.
- Calendar booking: she only offers times the owner is free and books into Google Calendar, Outlook and other calendar tools.
- Urgent calls: the owner decides what counts as urgent. Sara rings the owner's mobile, briefs them in seconds and puts the caller through. Complaints go straight to the owner.
- Memory: on the phone and on WhatsApp, Sara recognises returning customers and picks up where the last conversation ended.
- Recaps: every call and chat is saved in the Lead Awaker dashboard with a transcript and a short recap. The owner also gets each recap by email or WhatsApp when the conversation ends.
- Limits: she works from a brief. If the answer is not in her brief she takes a message and sends the question to the owner. She does not make up prices.

## Who it is for

Businesses where the owner or team is too busy working to answer the phone: trades and home services (plumbers, electricians, builders), car dealers, dental and medical practices, salons and barbers, gyms, hotels, law firms and similar appointment-based businesses.

## Setup and pricing

- Live in about 2 weeks: kick-off call (day 1), building the brief (days 2 to 5), quality tests (days 6 to 9), the owner tests her (days 10 to 12), switch on (day 14), then ongoing review and improvement.
- Nothing goes live until the owner has tested her and signed off. She can be paused at any time.
- Pricing: one fixed monthly fee based on call volume, confirmed in writing on the first call. No per-minute billing.
- Languages: English, Dutch and Portuguese.
- Data: conversations are stored on servers in the Netherlands. AI providers work under data processing agreements. The business can read or delete any conversation.

## Other service: database reactivation

Lead Awaker also reactivates old leads: an AI-run WhatsApp conversation re-contacts leads that went quiet (old quotes, enquiries that never booked) and books the interested ones into the calendar.
